author: /root/regression_fixture_audit
independence: Authored acceptance only, did not implement runtime or deploy UI change.
requirements: REP-050 clarified by user and synchronized main spec

review.scope: Only page/CSS changes affect application behavior. Storage, projection, runtime, prompts and schemas unchanged.
review.layout: Grade/title are noninteractive. Reason and optional native level scale precede a dedicated evidence button. Its aria-controls resolves to its immediate following panel, final element in card; toggle handler and expanded/hidden state pair verified.
review.data: Defining conditions are hidden in DOM and unchanged in candidate input and actual projection. Optional/empty reason or scale creates no invented headings or values. Evidence remains associated with the same criterion.
review.safety: Existing HTML-escaping, exact content/order, paragraph/list, partial-scale and prompt-policy tests retained.

limits: Synthetic actual React SSR and stateless component interaction only. No claim of real candidate processing or postdeployment browser verification.
